name: elizaos-plugin-coinrailz
description: Official ElizaOS plugin for Coin Railz (PR #8382). Yield-While-Trading on Base (Aave/Compound/Morpho) + Solana (Kamino). x402 services include NASA satellite data, Robinhood Chain, B20 compliance, prediction markets, AI inference, IoT/DePIN, vltUSDC vault operations, and execution. Non-custodial treasury management.

COINRAILZ_API_KEY.description: Prepaid credits API key (recommended). Get one at coinrailz.com/api-keys.

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Base mainnet private key for autonomous x402 payments (alternative to API key).

SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Solana private key (base58 or JSON array) for auto-signing USDC yield deposits. Optional — unsigned bundle returned if not set.

SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com

COIN_RAILZ_URL.description: Override platform URL. Defaults to https://coinrailz.com

author: Coin Railz
